title: Plant Manager- tissue and paper manufacturing
text:
This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for a proven manufacturing executive with deep **paper manufacturing and paper machine operations experience**. Our client is seeking a hands-on, results-driven leader who can take full ownership of plant performance, strengthen operational discipline, and lead the facility to improved results across **safety, quality, production, reliability, cost and people development**.

The successful candidate will be responsible for all aspects of plant operations and will play a key role in driving performance improvements, stabilizing underperforming areas, and building a strong culture of accountability, teamwork and continuous improvement.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

This role is ideal for a seasoned Plant Manager or senior operations leader who understands the complexity of paper manufacturing and has a track record of improving plant performance through strong leadership, technical knowledge, disciplined execution and data-driven decision-making.

The Plant Manager will oversee the day-to-day and strategic leadership of the facility, ensuring the plant operates safely, efficiently and profitably while developing both leadership and frontline teams.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead all plant operations to achieve established **safety, quality, production, reliability and financial objectives**.
* Build and reinforce a strong **safety culture** through visible leadership, clear expectations, coaching and accountability at all levels of the organization.
* Oversee plant performance and ensure operations are aligned with productivity, quality and cost targets.
* Optimize **paper machine performance**, equipment uptime, production output and finished-product quality.
* Improve equipment reliability through strong maintenance systems, including preventive and predictive maintenance, planning and scheduling, and root cause analysis.
* Manage and improve plant financial performance, including cost-per-ton, labour, maintenance, fibre, chemical and energy costs.
* Lead continuous improvement efforts using structured, data-driven problem-solving methodologies to improve operational and financial results.
* Develop and execute recovery or turnaround plans for underperforming operations, establishing clear priorities, ownership, milestones and measurable outcomes.
* Build, coach and strengthen plant leadership, technical and hourly teams through employee development, performance management, succession planning and accountability.
* Partner with maintenance, production, quality and leadership teams to ensure cross-functional alignment and effective execution of plant priorities.
* Establish a culture focused on **performance, engagement, ownership and continuous improvement**.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a strong plant leader with deep technical and operational knowledge of **paper manufacturing**, particularly **paper machine operations**, who can lead a large team and drive measurable business results.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing** or a related field is preferred.
* 10–15+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* **Must have direct paper manufacturing experience**, including demonstrated technical knowledge of **paper machine operations**.
* Proven experience leading paper machine operations and delivering sustainable improvements in performance, reliability and quality.
* Demonstrated success improving underperforming facilities or leading plant turnaround/recovery initiatives.
* Strong understanding of **papermaking processes, maintenance and reliability systems, plant operations and financial management**.
* Experience managing key manufacturing metrics, including productivity, equipment uptime, cost control and quality performance.
* Proven ability to lead large teams, develop talent, drive accountability and guide organizational change effectively.
* Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence performance at all levels of the plant.

Pay: $150,000.00 - $180,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Enter your email
* Available time for call

Experience:

* tissue and paper manufacturing operation: 10 years (Required)

Work Location: On the road
